stmercedesmuseum.name: Mercedes-Benz Museum
stmercedesmuseum.slogan: A spiral through 130 years of the automobile, in a building that curls.
stmercedesmuseum.line: Opened in May 2006, it holds more than 160 vehicles inside a double-helix building by UNStudio.

stludwigsburgschloss.name: Ludwigsburg Palace
stludwigsburgschloss.slogan: Swabia's Versailles, with 452 rooms and a duke's grand ambitions.
stludwigsburgschloss.line: Built from 1704 to 1733, its 18 buildings make it one of the largest Baroque palaces in Germany.

sthohenzollern.name: Hohenzollern Castle
sthohenzollern.slogan: A fairytale crown on a lone Swabian hilltop.
sthohenzollern.line: This is the third castle on the hill: the first fell in 1423 after a siege, the current one was finished in 1867.

stporschemuseum.name: Porsche Museum
stporschemuseum.slogan: A 35,000-tonne monolith that seems to float over Zuffenhausen.
stporschemuseum.line: Opened in January 2009, its steel exhibition block spans up to 60 metres between its supporting cores.

sthoelderlinturm.name: Hölderlin Tower
sthoelderlinturm.slogan: A yellow tower on the Neckar where a poet spent his quiet years.
sthoelderlinturm.line: My heart awakened to life in your valleys.
